pr.title: Refs #33497 -- Added connection pool support for PostgreSQL.

intent.summary: Add opt-in psycopg3 connection pooling to the PostgreSQL backend via OPTIONS['pool'] (Django ticket #33497). Pool is created lazily per alias, connections are configured (timezone, assume_role) by the pool's configure callback, and returned to the pool on close. Must not regress non-pooled behavior (timezone/role init, health checks, test DB cloning/destroy) and must reject incompatible config (CONN_MAX_AGE != 0, psycopg2).
